facts.text: Administrators can query production and sandbox environments, set up notifications, and view telemetry via the Admin Center API.
Service-to-service Microsoft Entra authentication supported from version 20.0 onwards.
Register an application in Microsoft Entra ID, specifying name and supported account types (single-tenant or multitenant).
Create a client secret in Certificates & Secrets, copy the secret value for use in client code.
Grant AdminCenter.ReadWrite.All permission to the Dynamics 365 Business Central API; optionally grant API.ReadWrite.All and Automation.ReadWrite.All.
Authorize the application in the admin center Authorized Microsoft Entra apps page by pasting the Application (client) ID.
The API endpoint is located at https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com.
For delegated authentication, select delegated permissions from Dynamics 365 Business Central after registering the application.
